name: Interbol-1
about: Interbol-1 (1995-039A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1995 Aug  2. Its phases from GCAT: 10.99S 0.18E. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
